- Does it still look like you? The model redraws your face from the reference, so it can drift a little.

If either one is off, tell me and I'll make another version. I can also change the colours, layout or background.

One more limit: 640px is the highest size on the free plan, and YouTube recommends 1280×720. The image will still upload fine, but it may look a bit soft on large screens.
